shape_push_v1.description: One learned identity-blind goal-conditioned planar EE continuation policy, with a deterministic geometry-checked contact initializer. Revised target avoids unverified contact-point truth.
shape_push_v1.model_family: pooled visible-support encoder and three-component heavy-tailed displacement mixture
shape_push_v1.architecture_rationale: The supplied planner handles connecting motion. Visible rigid-flow goals and measured robot displacement support low-dimensional continuation learning without full actor topology, physical tip calibration or force labels. A 32-unit shared point encoder plus64/48-unit head is appropriate for two episodes; diffusion over motor trajectories would add variance and unsupported dimensions. Contact initialization uses an explicit kinematic/accessibility prior, not trained boundary labels.

preprocessing.sampling: 2Hz in original interaction intervals plus all47 prior anchors, deduplicated by source
preprocessing.goal: bidirectional LK and rigid consensus on visible support; never complete actor boundary labels

data_plan.rationale: Preserve original source_plan and its12 semantic interaction groups as source references and sampler groups. Materialize the two complete original episodes to permit causal context and exact source accounting without overlapping copies. Target searches still stop at their original interaction-group boundary. This is data regrouping within the authorized cut/prior, not a new cut-stage experiment. All16745 rows retain context/executor roles.
data_plan.changes_from_prior: The previous contact-label cache was blocked because masks invented outer boundaries/holes and tip calibration could not certify physical support. We do NOT relabel those rows valid. Replace physical contact/direction/length classification with directly measured short planar EE displacement, conditioned on causal visible occupied support, EE state/history and an achieved local rigid-flow goal. Current components are partial support observations, NOT full actor extent; shape topology is not a target. Bidirectional optical flow, rigid consensus, split-fit agreement and differential plane-height sensitivity validate goals independently of silhouette completeness. Two-Hz sampling expands beyond original47 while keeping source/event grouping. Learned continuation replaces learned initial contact selection; a deterministic goal-displacement/accessibility initializer now handles first contact using commissioned complete geometry. This reduced prior cannot claim learned autonomous contact selection. Original files, assessments, failed caches and immutable journaled versions remain retained.

segments.rationale: Complete authorized A context. Supervision searches original six interaction groups; A training only.
Complete authorized B context. Original six groups retained; B development, not untouched test.

dependencies: PyTorch, numpy, scipy and OpenCV from locked environment. Offline visible brown support is an inferred recording-specific observation extractor, not a segmentation/semantic model or complete geometry claim. Optional online class-agnostic inventory uses frozen SAM2.1 Hiera-small, Apache-2.0, https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/segment_anything_2/092824/sam2.1_hiera_small.pt, SHA2566d1aa6f30de5c92224f8172114de081d104bbd23dd9dc5c58996f0cad5dc4d38. No downloaded Qwen and no trained recorded-alphabet classifier; the supplied visual Agent owns semantic identity, injective instance assignment and explicit layout. All perception proposals require causal association/validation; no hidden full-instance annotations are assumed.
adaptations: Use defensible measured EE motion rather than force/contact pseudo-truth. No exact physical tip or table-clearance value is needed for offline displacement supervision. Absolute visual chart is uncertain8mm; differential flow uncertainty is separately propagated under height perturbation. Initial contact/full-envelope/controller commissioning remains required for physical execution, not offline training. Runtime accepts current geometry/explicit goals and never accesses recordings/future images. Generic SAM proposals support new colors/shapes, but semantics and geometric validation belong to upstream Agent/sensing. Only push-letter sources were supplied; flip-egg authorization has no corresponding assignment or recordings here.
limitations: Two same-inventory episodes support only provisional same-domain continuation learning. Temporal rows are correlated and B informed design. No physical execution, task success, independent generalization, autonomous semantic tracking or full geometry validation has been measured. Learned continuation only covers low-tool approximately fixed-orientation planar prefixes; arbitrary tilted strokes and free travel remain planner/replanning responsibilities. Deterministic initial-contact prior and novel-shape behavior need physical evaluation. SAM inventory is proposals, not a commissioned scene provider. Source-specific brown support extraction is not relied on for unseen-color deployment; perception distribution shift must be evaluated independently.
